authors: Warnken KW, Lawlor AJ, Lofts S, Tipping E, Davison W, Zhang H
title: In situ speciation measurements of trace metals in headwater streams
why_relevant: 34 streams pH 4.1-8.3 with DGT and filtered Al, Fe, Mn, Ni, Cu, Cd, Pb, Zn
access: open; SI supplied in round 2b and EXTRACTED
data_expected: Main text has no per-stream tables (Figs. 1-3 group points only by pH class and DOC class). SI Tables S1-S9 (per-stream pH, DOC, major ions, filtered and DGT metals) needed for quality-A slopes and DOC-held-constant fits; highest-value missing file in this set.

authors: Tipping E, Vincent CD, Lawlor AJ, Lofts S
title: Metal accumulation by stream bryophytes, related to chemical speciation
why_relevant: Same 34 northern-England streams as Warnken2009; may tabulate per-site pH, DOC and filtered metals
data_expected: Possibly per-site water chemistry (pH, DOC, filtered metals) for the Warnken streams, to pair with Warnken DGT values if the ES&T SI cannot be obtained.

authors: Han S, Naito W, Hanai Y, Masunaga S
title: Evaluation of trace metals bioavailability in Japanese river waters using DGT and a chemical equilibrium model

authors: Omanović D, Pižeta I, Vukosav P, Kovács E, Frančišković-Bilinski S, Tamás J
